segments.text: Quill records meetings on a Mac and transcribes them locally. And the engineering choices are all about surviving a crash. Audio writes as CF
rather than M4A because CAF needs no finalization pass. So a session killed midme still leaves a readable file. The
file system acts as the job cue. So anything unfinished picks up on next launch. There's a doctor command purely so you aren't downloading a 600 megabyte
